citation: E. F. May, J. Y. Guo, J. H. Oakley, T. J. Hughes, B. F. Graham, K. N. Marsh, and S. H. Huang, Reference Quality Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium Data for the Binary Systems Methane + Ethane, + Propane, + Butane and, + 2-Methylpropane, at Temperatures from (203 to 273) K and Pressures to 9 MPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 2015, 60(12), 3606-3620.
raw_snapshot_policy: The NIST JSON was inspected and hashed but is not redistributed because the archive page does not state a redistribution license. The normalized numerical facts, exact URL and SHA-256, pairing provenance, and deterministic extractor are retained. Ordinary validation is fully offline.

skipped_identical_repeats.policy: Each butane binary lists one measurement twice, identical in T, x, P and y; the extractor's skip_identical_duplicates keeps the first copy. A repeated key with any differing value is still rejected.

extraction: Rows extracted by tools/extract_may_2015_thermoml.py (BUTANE_SYSTEMS, BUTANE_COMPOUNDS, skip_identical_duplicates=True) from the NIST ThermoML JSON whose SHA-256 matched raw_json_sha256, on 1 November 2026 (PR 27, docs/investigations/butane_preview_points.csv, byte-identical). Re-extract with: uv run python tools/extract_may_2015_thermoml.py --input RECORD.json --output data/experimental/may_2015_butanes_vle.csv --butanes
status: Validation data only; the butane components are admitted once verified Yang & Richter (2025) Table 5 constants are entered (docs/BUTANES_ADMISSION_PLAN.md).
